notes.title: Finance snapshot 2026-09-23 (Moneybird)
notes.body:
**YTD 2026 (1 Jan–21 Sep)**
- Revenue €1,617,074
- Gross profit €472,001 (29.2%)
- Operating profit €53,816 (3.3%)
- Net profit €37,466 (2.3%)

**August 2026**
- Revenue €152,835
- Gross profit €42,355 (27.7%)
- Net result −€3,579

**Receivables (21 Sep)**
- Open €115,305 across 44 invoices
- Overdue €85,325 across 28 invoices (late €85,149 + reminded €5,455 + open €24,701 not yet due)
- Oldest overdue due date 2026-03-24

**Read**
- Net margin 2.3% vs 12% target: the gap is structural, not a bad month. Gross margin 29% vs 35% target is the lever; the rest is opex (~€480k YTD in expenses lines).
- Run-rate ≈ €2.24M vs €3M goal: revenue is not the problem, margin is.
- €85k overdue is ~7 weeks of net profit sitting in other people's bank accounts.

Source: Moneybird profit_loss_report (this_year, prev_month), list_invoices (period this_year, state late|reminded|open|pending_payment), pulled 2026-09-21 via connector.
